defs.def: unusual or surprising, especially in a way that is difficult to understand 奇怪的；奇特的；异常的

ex.s: Mum voiced what we were all thinking: It was strange to see the place so empty.
ex.t: 妈妈说出了我们所有人的想法：看到这个地方如此空荡荡，感觉很奇怪。

ex.s: The couple had both gone to work, so it was strange that someone was over there.
ex.t: 那对夫妇都去上班了，所以那边有人显得很奇怪。

ex.s: The question,“What do elephants and fish have in common?" may sound strange but researchers have found that they both have a feature not observed in any other creature.
ex.t: "大象和鱼有什么共同点？"这个问题听起来可能很奇怪，但研究人员发现它们都有一个在其他生物身上没有观察到的特征。

ex.s: Strange, isn't it?
ex.t: 很奇怪，不是吗？

ex.s: "His comment struck me as strange.
ex.t: 他的评论让我感到奇怪。

ex.s: I reported the strange surface on the skin of the lizard to my husband and children the next morning.
ex.t: 第二天早上我把蜥蜴皮肤上的异常情况报告给了丈夫和孩子。

ex.s: It’s this strange form that makes race walking such an attractive activity, however, says Jaclyn Norberg, an assistant professor of exercise science at Salem State University in Salem, Mass.
ex.t: 然而，位于马萨诸塞州塞勒姆的塞勒姆州立大学运动科学助理教授Jaclyn Norberg说，正是这种奇特的形式使竞走成为一项如此有吸引力的运动。

ex.s: But the sport’s strange form does place considerable stress on the ankles and hips, so people with a history of such injuries might want to be cautious in adopting the sport.
ex.t: 但这种运动奇特的形式确实给脚踝和髋部带来相当大的压力，所以有此类损伤史的人采用这项运动时可能要谨慎。

ex.s: Sending smiling faces to colleagues may seem strange
ex.t: 给同事发送笑脸表情似乎很奇怪。

ex.s: I realised there was something strange about me.
ex.t: 我意识到我身上有某种奇怪之处。

ex.s: His strange habit makes sense when you consider that he’s an environmental scientist who studies how to reduce litter, including things that fall off garbage trucks as they drive down the road.
ex.t: 他奇怪的习惯在你想到他是一位研究如何减少垃圾的环境科学家时就有道理了，包括研究那些在垃圾车沿路行驶时从车上掉落的东西。

ex.s: When I was a little girl， my family moved to a tiny town at the bottom of a big mountain． One day after school， while exploring the green woods of this magnificent mountain， I almost fell on a set of stairs． What could these steps lead to？ Curiosity got the best of me as I knew it would be starting to get dark soon． I started climbing up those strangely mysterious steps．
ex.t: 当我还是个小女孩时，我家搬到了一座大山脚下的一个小镇。有一天放学后，在探索这座壮丽山峰的翠绿树林时，我差点被一段台阶绊倒。这些台阶会通向哪里呢？好奇心占了上风，因为我知道天很快就要黑了。我开始攀登那些神秘莫测的台阶。

ex.s: It might seem strange to hoard a bunch of processed, strung-together shells, but what is a pile of dollars?
ex.t: 囤积一堆经过加工、串在一起的贝壳似乎有些奇怪，但一堆美元又算是什么呢？

ex.s: One strange family trip we took when I was eleven tells a lot about her.
ex.t: 我十一岁时我们家一次奇怪的旅行很能说明她这个人。

ex.s: Why did the author feel strange about herself after listening to the recording? (no more than 10 words)
ex.t: 听完录音后作者为什么觉得自己奇怪？（不超过10词）

ex.s: Misadventures in English (18 pictures) (picture 1) Last week, our forum asked if you had any funny or strange stories about using English.
ex.t: 英语中的不幸事件（ 18张图片） （图片1 ）上周，我们的论坛询问您是否有任何关于使用英语的有趣或奇怪的故事。

ex.s: Strangely, his beard is still red even though his hair is turning grey!
ex.t: 奇怪的是，他的胡子还是红色的，尽管他的头发开始变白了！

ex.s: Stars after the storm 1 It’s strange, but I don’t really remember much about the hurricane itself.
ex.t: 暴风之后的星星：很奇怪，但我真的不太记得飓风本身的事了。

defs.def: not familiar because you have not been there before or met the person before 陌生的；不熟悉的

ex.s: I once wrote a paper on the influence of fairy tales on Roald Dahl's writing and it gave me a new appreciation for his strange and delightful words.
ex.t: 我曾写过一篇关于童话对罗尔德·达尔写作影响的论文，它让我对他的奇异而妙趣横生的文字有了新的欣赏。

ex.s: He was actually a stranger to books.
ex.t: 他实际上是个书本陌生人。

ex.s: This stranger became my cheerleader, as if it was his mission to lift me up from my  28 .
ex.t: 这位陌生人成了我的啦啦队长，仿佛他的使命就是把我从28 中拉起来。

ex.s: A simple greeting in their mother tongue can guarantee a smile from a total stranger and a tired traveller.
ex.t: 用他们的母语简单问候一句，就能让一个完全陌生的人和疲惫的旅客露出微笑。

ex.s: It is the story of an American travelling to a strange land, and of the people he meets on his way: Rustam, his translator, a lovely 24-year-old who picked up his colorful English in California, Oleg and Natasha, his hosts in Tashkent, and a string of foreign aid workers.
ex.t: 这是一位美国人旅行到一个陌生的地方的故事，还有他在路上遇到的人：鲁斯塔姆，他的翻译家，一个可爱的24岁少年，在加利福尼亚，奥列格和娜塔莎，他的东道主塔什干，以及一串外援工人。

ex.s: “They are simply a stranger to the land," said Redney C.
ex.t: “他们对陆地简直是陌生的，”雷德尼·C说。
